examples.english: When I was a child, I used to play a lot with watercolor paints.

notes:
Refers to the painting technique using water-soluble pigments, as well as paintings created with this medium. Commonly encountered in art education and gallery contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{水彩画|すいさいが}→水彩画：07077_suisaiga⟧: watercolor painting (the artwork)
- {水彩|すいさい}⟦{絵|え}の{具|ぐ}→絵の具：16182_enogu⟧: watercolor paints (the materials)
- ⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧{水彩|すいさい}: transparent watercolor
- ⟦{不透明|ふとうめい}→不透明：11365_futoumei⟧{水彩|すいさい}: opaque watercolor (gouache)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{油彩|ゆさい}→油彩：27155_yusai⟧: oil painting — uses oil-based paints; produces richer, more opaque colors
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧: oil painting — more colloquial than ⟦{油彩|ゆさい}→油彩：27155_yusai⟧
- ⟦{色鉛筆|いろえんぴつ}→色鉛筆：28370_iroenpitsu⟧: colored pencils — a dry drawing medium, not paint-based
